hero.description: VHG Logistics provides end-to-end fulfillment with a modern warehouse system in Northern Vietnam. We handle receiving, inventory management, packing, labeling, and last-mile processing—helping businesses reduce operational burden and accelerate supply chains.

services.description: Flexible supply chain solutions tailored to each industry—helping businesses optimize operating costs and speed up market entry.

about.p1: An international logistics company with offices across major ports, focused in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Guangzhou, and Moscow. Our experienced, multinational team is committed to making complex cross-border routes simple, transparent, and secure.
about.p2Suffix: lanes for consumer goods, household items, and e-commerce.

services.title: Cross-border transportation
services.description: Strong coverage on key China–Vietnam and Southeast Asia lanes. Official customs clearance with fixed departures so partners can plan supply confidently.

services.title: Multimodal transport
services.description: Door-to-Door solutions for Russia–Vietnam and global routes. Flexible sea (FCL/LCL), road, and air combinations with competitive rates from leading carriers.

services.title: Warehousing & B2B fulfillment
services.description: Standardized warehouse in Dong Anh, Hanoi. Real-time inventory management, professional packing, and accurate order processing.

services.title: Customs & import-export entrustment
services.description: Local policy expertise with clearance within up to 36 hours. End-to-end legal procedures and documents (C/O Form E...), ensuring smooth cargo flow.
